name: ML-object-detection-project
description: Detect football players in videos using YOLOv5 for training and YOLOv8 for inference. The dataset is sourced from Roboflow and includes 663 annotated images. The project involves pre-processing, augmentation, and model training for accurate player detection.

paragraphs: An experimental offline pipeline now adds shot-local BoT-SORT tracking, pinned PnLCalib reconstruction, bounded visual predictions, observed possession/events, coverage, heatmaps and a local Streamlit dashboard with synchronized video seeking. Possession-change inference is fully automatic from stable controlling-team colour changes, with per-frame evidence and CPU reprocessing of saved tracks. The broadcast iteration adds tiled ball detection, an optional separate adapted ball checkpoint, observed visible-group geometry and an independent annotation interface.
